name: polish
description: Cleans up dictated prompts with Haiku: drops the ums, false starts and spoken punctuation, and spells your jargon right. Learns your vocabulary as you type.

mode.title: When to clean a prompt
mode.description: auto cleans a prompt only when it reads like dictation (fillers, stutters, spoken punctuation, one long run-on). always cleans every prompt you type. off never does. Each cleaned prompt is one small Haiku request. A choice made with /polish is remembered and wins over this setting.

review.title: Send the cleaned prompt or show it first
review.description: send sends the cleaned prompt at once (Claude also gets your raw words as a hidden note). review puts the cleaned prompt back in the box and waits for Enter.
